hooks.name: Copy check
hooks.description: Reviews user-facing strings in a saved feature component. Reports problems only.

action.prompt: Copy check for the file that was just saved. Read only that file and .kiro/steering/style.md. Check user-facing strings only (JSX text, aria-label, title, placeholder, alt, and toast or announcement messages). Flag: any em dash character; copy that is not short, playful and spooky-cute per the UI copy voice in style.md (for example gory or harsh words); and copy that is unclear about what to tap next. Report only problems as a short list of file, line and suggested fix. If there are no problems, reply with one line: Copy check passed. Do not edit any files.
